methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.status: live, no read on IT services yet
theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30 (ChatGPT), but there is no sell-side or price read on IT services yet and the stock trades at 23.7x FY23E — near its own median, not an AI discount. Re-file under AI_EXPOSED only when the multiple starts discounting deflation or GenAI shows up as shrinking billable hours.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.76x; +32% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.31; conservative 2yr +6%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (the decade's worst year, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (decade CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run of the decade); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-01-06) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.76x (26.5% downside to Bear $198 / +34.8% upside to Bull $363) | Adj composite 3.09 vs market 2.78: gap +0.31 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +32% above the EPP floor $204 (18x FY23E $11.36) | Conservative 2-yr case: +6.4% total (+3.2%/yr) | At 23.7x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $356 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; consulting +10% LC in Q1, Q2 guided +6-10% LC; GenAI is live but there is no read yet on what it does to IT services.
